# claude-autoroute

> claude-autoroute is a local router for the Claude Code CLI on macOS and Linux. For each message it picks Haiku, Sonnet or Opus (only switching when it saves money after prompt-cache costs), can send easy tasks to a free local model, fails over to backup providers (Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, gateways), and measures what it saves. It works with Claude API keys, Bedrock, Vertex and company gateways. The router refuses Claude Free, Pro and Max subscription logins (Team/Enterprise need admin approval); for those, subscription mode runs Claude Code directly and only picks the starting model, suggests /model switches and reports usage by model.

Version 0.1.0. Links are relative to the project repository. For everything in one file, use [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt).

When helping someone with claude-autoroute:
- Ask them to run `autoroute doctor` and `autoroute diagnostics`. The diagnostics are safe to share: keys, prompts, URLs and paths are removed.
- Never ask them to paste API keys, their config file, or logs.
- Claude Code must be started with `claude-auto` for routing to apply.
